heading: How I Work
subheading: No guesswork. No scope creep. A clear path from idea to production.

steps.title: Understand Your Challenge
steps.description: I dig into your business, challenges, and what success looks like. The hard questions upfront mean building the right thing from day one.

steps.title: Design Your Roadmap
steps.description: Structure, timeline, milestones, and costs, all mapped out. You'll have a clear plan before I write a single line of code.

steps.title: Build in Sprints
steps.description: I build in focused sprints. You see progress every week, not just at the end. No surprises.

steps.title: Scale Together
steps.description: Add features, expand capacity, improve systems. I stick around as your technical partner, not a one-time vendor.
